clauses.quote: Written notice of surplus status will be given, when possible, by March 15 for elementary teachers and by April 1 for secondary teachers.
Surplus teachers, who qualify for available positions, shall be placed before any applicants new to Granite School District are considered.
After a surplus teacher is placed, that teacher has the opportunity to apply for any specific position in another school that is posted as a vacancy.

Before recommending a teacher transfer, the principal and/or the appropriate School Leadership and Improvement Director will meet with the teacher involved to discuss the proposed transfer and the reasons thereof.
clauses.subject_text: the principal and/or the appropriate School Leadership and Improvement Director

clauses.quote: No administrative transfer will be made arbitrarily, capriciously, or without a written explanation of the reason for the transfer.
If the teacher objects to the proposed transfer, the teacher may request a meeting with the appropriate School Leadership and Improvement Director to discuss the matter.
Administrative transfers will be recommended by the principal and/or the appropriate School Leadership and Improvement Director
Administrative transfers will take effect only after approval by the appropriate Assistant Superintendent.
Human Resources, in consultation with the Executive Director of the Association, may administratively transfer teachers on a .5 FTE in two locations to a single location 1.0 FTE.
In filling promotional vacancies, preference shall be given to personnel already employed in the District providing other qualifications are substantially equal.
Applicants for such promotions shall be notified of the final decision in writing.
